title: Spend Cap Button
description: Prevents duplicate purchases and overspending: it remembers recent buys of the same item ("You bought this 3 min ago", including a double-click a second ago) and needs a deliberate second click to buy again, previews this purchase as a slice of each daily or monthly cap, and blocks any spend that would break a cap with the overage and when it resets.
stops: Same item bought twice by mistake
